label: main

tools.source: interlock host tools go-dotted-section --role worker --host claude-code

sessions.final_text:
I fixed `splitName` in `cmd/kvconf/main.go` so it splits on the last dot. `db.eu.host` is now the key `host` in the section `db.eu`, and a name with no dot is still a key in the unnamed section.

I added `TestSplitName` in `cmd/kvconf/main_test.go`, covering names with no dot, one dot and several dots. interlock ran `checks/dotted.sh`, which now prints `db1.example.org`, and `go test ./...`, which passes. I recorded claims for `repro` (observed), `regression` (tested) and `spec` (tested). The `repro` and `spec` criteria still need the independent verifier.

- repro: passes (observed). interlock ran `checks/dotted.sh` on tree b7de6fb and it printed `db1.example.org`. I also ran `kvconf get` on `db.eu.host` by hand and got the value.
- spec: passes (tested). `TestSplitName` covers no dot, one dot and several dots, and it passes. By hand, `get top` returned `1` from the unnamed section and `get db.eu.host` returned `h`.
- regression: passes (tested). interlock ran `go test ./...` on this tree and both packages passed.

checks_run:
interlock claim add --criterion repro --strength observed --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "checks/dotted.sh prints db1.example.org"
interlock claim add --criterion regression --strength tested --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passes"
interlock claim add --criterion spec --strength tested --tree auto --ref "go test ./cmd/kvconf (TestSplitName)" --note "TestSplitName covers no-dot, one-dot, multi-dot names; passes in go test ./..."

git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; interlock check run --criterion repro; interlock check run --criterion regression; grep -n -B2 -A15 "func splitName" cmd/kvconf/main.go; go test ./cmd/... -run TestSplitName -v

grep -n -A25 "func TestSplitName" cmd/kvconf/main_test.go; cd /tmp && printf 'top = 1
[db.eu]
host = h
' > /tmp/a.conf; cd - >/dev/null; go run ./cmd/kvconf get /tmp/a.conf top; go run ./cmd/kvconf get /tmp/a.conf db.eu.host

interlock assess add --criterion repro --strength observed --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "checks/dotted.sh passed on tree b7de6fb, printed db1.example.org; manual get db.eu.host also works"
interlock assess add --criterion spec --strength tested --ref "go test ./cmd/... -run TestSplitName -v" --note "TestSplitName covers no-dot, one-dot, multi-dot; passes. Manual: get top -> 1 (unnamed section), db.eu.host -> h"
interlock assess add --criterion regression --strength tested --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passes on this tree"
